analyst.text: Milwaukee's locker room is showing strain. Kyle Kuzma, Tyler Herro and Jaime Jaquez Jr. have all called for more urgency during the worst start since 1993-94, and Taylor Jenkins is preaching "stay the course." Kuzma faces the Lakers, his former team, while the Lakers ride a six-game streak with Luka Doncic back. Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (finger) have no timetable. The mental edge leans to the Lakers, with Milwaukee on a back-to-back.
